name: API Smoke Probe
description: Run lightweight checks against HTTP APIs, assert status codes and JSON fields, and notify on failures.
highlights: Runs GET and POST smoke checks
Supports environment variable interpolation in headers and bodies

name: GitHub Release Radar
description: Watch a list of repositories for new GitHub releases and post a release digest to WEBHOOK_URL.
highlights: Tracks release activity across multiple repos
Summarizes release notes in one digest
Supports authenticated or anonymous GitHub API access

name: Remote Dataset Daily Report
description: Download a remote CSV or JSON dataset, compute daily aggregates, detect anomalies, and post a summary report.
highlights: Supports both CSV and JSON datasets
Computes grouped summaries and numeric stats
Flags anomalies using simple threshold rules

name: RSS Keyword Radar
description: Fetch recent RSS and Atom items, filter them by keyword, and send a markdown digest to WEBHOOK_URL.
highlights: Scans multiple RSS and Atom feeds
Builds a digest for the last 24 hours

name: URL Digest Batch
description: Fetch a batch of URLs, extract readable text, and produce a digest with per-page and overall summaries.
highlights: Fetches and extracts multiple URLs in one run
Falls back to HTML parsing when text extraction fails

name: Website Availability Check
description: Check site status codes, latency, and required text snippets. Notify only on failure by default.
highlights: Checks status code, latency, and page content
Fails fast when any required assertion breaks
Only sends success alerts if you opt in
